name: Doctors
overview: Scripture acknowledges the role of doctors as those who provide physical healing, as seen when Joseph commands physicians to embalm his father (Genesis 50:2) and Jeremiah laments the lack of a physician to heal his people (Jeremiah 8:22). However, the Bible also critiques ineffective healers (Job 13:4) and points to the greater need for spiritual healing, with Jesus declaring that He came for the spiritually sick, not the whole, likening Himself to a physician for sinners (Matthew 9:12; Mark 2:17). Additionally, Proverbs highlights the connection between emotional health and physical well-being, reminding believers that a joyful heart acts like medicine.
